examples.title: Leaf then intermediate, against the root

description: RFC 5280 §6.1 validation of a path YOU ordered (`path`, leaf first, then each issuer) against YOUR `trustAnchors` at `at`: validity, basic constraints, key usage, name constraints and the `policy` inputs. By default every link signature is verified first — certificate i against i+1, the last against the anchor whose subject matches its issuer — and reported per link in signatures[] (PKI_REASON_SIGNATURE_INVALID fails the verdict). `checkSignatures:false` gives a structural verdict: `valid` stays false (PKI_REASON_SIGNATURE_NOT_CHECKED on every link) and `failingReasons` carries what actually fails; `signaturesChecked` says which one you got. No revocation here (verify_certificate_chain judges CRL / OCSP evidence; check_crl_revocation / check_ocsp_status judge one certificate). A negative verdict is valid:false + reasons[], never isError. Pin `at` for a reproducible, cacheable verdict. SHA-1 signatures need allowSha1:true. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary'.

allowSha1.description: Accept or produce SHA-1 signatures (legacy material you already trust). Default false: refused with PKI_CRYPTO_ALGORITHM_REFUSED on read, VALIDATION_ERROR on write.

at.description: The instant the verdict is evaluated at. An ISO 8601 date-time (UTC unless zoned; e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z), epoch milliseconds as digits, or 'now'. Omitted: PKINATIVE_MCP_AT when the operator pinned it, else the wall clock (a clock-dependent result is never cached).

checkSignatures.description: Verify every link signature before validating (certificate i against i+1, the last against the anchor whose subject is its issuer). false = structural verdict only: PKI_REASON_SIGNATURE_NOT_CHECKED stays in reasons[], signaturesChecked:false.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

path.description: The path to validate, leaf FIRST, then each issuer up to (but not necessarily including) the anchor (every PEM block of every item is taken). Every PEM block of every item is taken, in order.

items.description: The path to validate, leaf FIRST, then each issuer up to (but not necessarily including) the anchor: exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

inhibitAnyPolicy.description: initial-any-policy-inhibit: anyPolicy is not a match.

requireExplicitPolicy.description: initial-explicit-policy: every certificate must carry an acceptable policy.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

trustAnchors.description: Trust anchors (root certificates you trust) (every PEM block of every item is taken). At least one is required: a verdict is relative to the anchors you name.

items.description: Trust anchors (root certificates you trust): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

name: validate_certificate_path

outputSchema.description: Path validation verdict. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

evaluatedAt.description: The ISO instant used — re-pass it as `at` to reproduce the verdict.

failingReasons.description: The reasons that fail THIS call: reasons[] as is when the signatures were checked, minus the PKI_REASON_SIGNATURE_NOT_CHECKED markers otherwise. Empty = the path validates (structurally, when signaturesChecked is false).

errorCode.description: The PKI_* error the parser would have thrown (PKI_REASON_INPUT_MALFORMED).

path.description: The path as validated, leaf first, up to (and including) the trust anchor it reached.

reasons.description: Why the verdict is negative (empty when valid): the engine PKI_REASON_* codes, each with the standard it cites and the path of the offending element. A reason is returned, never thrown.

errorCode.description: The PKI_* error the parser would have thrown (PKI_REASON_INPUT_MALFORMED).

signatures.description: One row per certificate of the input path: the issuer it was verified against (the next certificate, or the matching anchor) and the verdict; not-checked when no issuer was found or checkSignatures is false.

valid.description: The engine verdict. With checkSignatures:false it is always false (every link is PKI_REASON_SIGNATURE_NOT_CHECKED): read failingReasons for the structural verdict.
